answer: New agents register by burning 50 reputation tokens into a public burn registry. First, the burn is recorded on-chain with a timestamp. Second, the agent earns a non-transferable badge only after 14 days of honest trades. Third, proven fraud slashes the badge and blacklists the entry for 180 days. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 500,000 tokens — $1,000,000 at $2 each — plus 140,000 days of waiting, while one honest badge costs a single burn and two weeks. Trust builds like shale, layer on layer, never handed out like ivory trinkets, deepening only where the river of honest work keeps flowing.
